title: Restriction of a matched example
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $z$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each coordinate in $P$, and let a matched example consist of a cube point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and a sign, with $x$ agreeing with $z$ on $P$. Its restriction is the pair consisting of the restriction of $x$ to coordinates outside $P$ and its sign.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $[n]$
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$
the sample is a matched example for $P$ and $z$
